targets.authors: Ronfeldt, M., Bardelli, E., Truwit, M., Mullman, H., Schaaf, K., & Baker, J. C.
targets.title: Improving preservice teachers’ feelings of preparedness to teach through recruitment of instructionally effective and experienced cooperating teachers: A randomized experiment
targets.evidence_quote: In this paper, we describe a pair of studies that build upon the “original” MMR evalu- ation (Ronfeldt et al., 2020) in two different ways. In the “replication study,” we re-imple- ment the original experiment (Cohort 1, 2018–19) with a different cohort of PSTs and CMs within the same EPP (Cohort 2, 2019–20).
targets.outcome_quote: First, across years, PSTs who completed their clinical placements in treated districts reported feeling more ready to teach than their peers in control districts. These results are consistent for the overall feelings of readiness factor and its twosub-factors, readiness in questioning skills and readiness in other instruc- tional skills. Compared to the original RCT, though, these differences are smaller in magnitude and not statistically significant in the replication study.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Mentor recruitment effects supported in new cohorts, but authors explicitly contrast nonsignificant readiness effects with the original RCT. Successful mentor recruitment addresses that component rather than all tested findings. New clinical assessment and workforce measures are extensions. Quote shows explicit contrary comparison; recruitment agreement is stated in results and discussion.

reasoning: Title, printed DOI and five authors verify identity. Two studies test the same 2020 paper: new-cohort RCT and new-program extension. Background ISTI and correlational papers are not targets. Reference-list citation copied instead of differently worded replication-statement citation. Author terminology reproduction refers to a new cohort, so record_type is replication.
